title: UzPainter capture receipt
description: The receipt of uzpainter.render.capture and of the worker's capture tool (src/python/capture.h; docs/architecture/07-preview-and-render-parity.md §5; decision 148), written beside the PNG as <stem>.receipt.json. Every member is always present; null where the mode has no such thing.

environment.description: The environment a painter_viewport capture is lit by: the project's, or with default true the installation's default (the shipped studio-small-09.exr) when the project names none, a non-parity preview (decision 212). Null for the diagnostic modes.

visibility.description: The self-occlusion of a painter_viewport capture (decision 251): its model and the visibility rays traced per hit for the diffuse and the specular term, also part of render_state_digest. Null for the diagnostic modes.

occlusion.description: The AO of a painter_viewport capture (decision 257): the AO mesh map of each texture set applied inside the self-occlusion rays as the per-ray weight mu^k about the faded shading normal (mu = cos of the ray to it, k = 2 (1 - a) / a, a = 1 + ao_strength (ao - 1)), whose cosine-weighted mean is a, the painted AO channel not applied, the normal map's cavity a_cav multiplied into a (decision 258), with the specular ratio the lesser of that one and a_cav times the ratio without it, and the albedo's painted occlusion compounded with it. Part of render_state_digest. Null for the diagnostic modes.

ao_source.description: Per texture set, in texture set order: the AO mesh map with its image's SHA-256, or none (ao = 1).

cavity.description: The normal map's cavity (decision 258): kappa = trace(J^-1 D), the divergence per world length of the slope (-t.x, -t.y) / max(t.z, slope_nz_min) of the normal slot's tangent-space normal t (D: central differences from four bilinear taps about a point, J: the hit triangle's UV Jacobian on the shading frame); the pixel footprint h from ray differentials (at least one texel per axis) is covered by min(ceil(h), 3) points per axis with tap spacing max(1, h / n) texels, and a_cav is the mean over them of 1 / (1 + radius max(0, kappa)); it is multiplied into the AO map's visible fraction, and the specular ratio is the lesser of that weighted ratio and a_cav times the ratio without it. radius is the physical radius in metres: radius_unit metre where the mesh states its unit or a mesh unit scale was given (the scene is in centimetres and the radius is applied as 0.025 scene units), mesh_unit_as_metre where it does not and its unit is read as the metre (0.00025 scene units).

shadows.description: The display state's shadows flag as requested and its effect on a painter_viewport capture: none, the pass always traces its self-occlusion (decision 251). Outside render_state_digest. Null for the diagnostic modes.

files.description: Returned with the receipt (absolute paths), never written into the receipt file.
